units.text: INT. CIRCUS FORTUNE-TELLER'S TENT - NIGHT
Velvet drapes, a round table, a glass ball glowing faintly from within.
Incense curls toward a patched canvas ceiling.
Outside, a calliope plays something slow and off-key.
MADAME ZORINA PETROVSKAYA-LUND (60s, turban, rings on every finger) lays out tarot cards.
Across from her, DETECTIVE MALCOLM OKORO-BRIGGS (40s, damp trench coat, hat in hands) watches.
In the corner, a boy, CASPIAN "CASS" WELLES (12, striped shirt, wide eyes) sits on a trunk, holding a cage of white mice.
Madame, you told the police you saw nothing.
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: I told the police what they wished to hear.
units.name: ZORINA

units.text: And what did you see?
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: She turns a card.
The Tower.
Lightning, falling figures.
A man in a gray suit, running from the big top at nine.
units.name: ZORINA

units.text: He had a red scarf.
units.name: CASS

units.text: Cass, were you there?
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: I was feeding the mice.
units.name: CASS

units.text: A TELEPHONE rings, shrill, on a shelf behind the curtain.
Everyone stiffens.
Zorina rises, parts the drape, lifts the receiver.
Yes.
units.name: ZORINA

units.text: Malcolm crosses and takes it from her.
Okoro-Briggs.
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: Sir, we found the scarf. Red wool. It was tied to the Ferris wheel.
units.name: SERGEANT

units.text: Anyone with it?
units.name: MALCOLM

units.text: No, sir. But the wheel is turning.
units.name: SERGEANT

units.text: Malcolm lowers the receiver.
Outside, the calliope stops.
In the silence, a distant, iron creak.
Zorina's rings click against the glass ball.
Detective, do not go out there.
units.name: ZORINA

units.text: Madame, I have to.
units.name: MALCOLM
